feed.title: United States Antimony Corporation to Participate in Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference This Week

The conference provides an opportunity for USAC to discuss its growth strategy, North American critical-minerals platform, and role in strengthening domestic supply chains with institutional investors. feed.title: Trump stuns Nvidia's Jensen Huang with an unexpected AI remark
feed.summary: Former President Donald Trump reportedly called AI a "hoax" during an unexpected onstage interaction with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to Seeking Alpha. This remark comes at a critical time when AI companies are heavily investing in infrastructure, with Nvidia being a major beneficiary of this buildout. Investors are now watching to see if political discourse will impact policies and spending that drive Nvidia's growth.

feed.title: RTX names Jill Albertelli president of Pratt & Whitney unit

Albertelli, who has over 30 years of experience at Pratt & Whitney, will succeed Shane Eddy, who is retiring. She previously led the Military Engines division and will report to RTX Chairman and CEO Chris Calio.

feed.title: Raymond James bank segment president to transition to consulting role
feed.summary: Raymond James Financial announced that Steve Raney, President of its Bank Segment for 21 years, will transition to an executive consulting role on January 1, 2027. Scott Curtis, Chief Operating Officer, will succeed Raney, who saw the bank segment's annual net revenues grow from $41 million to nearly $1.8 billion during his tenure. Tarek Helal, Chief Strategy Officer, will also expand his responsibilities to oversee the Asset Management Services division.

feed.title: Amex Graphite Business Card Review 2026: Is the $295 Fee Worth It?
feed.summary: The Amex Graphite Business Cash Unlimited Card, launched in March 2026, offers unlimited 2% cash back on eligible purchases and 5% on Amex Travel bookings, but carries a substantial $295 annual fee. Businesses need to spend at least $14,750 annually to offset this fee with cash back rewards. The card includes features like no preset spending limit, various protections, and a welcome bonus, making it potentially suitable for high-spending businesses or those with significant travel budgets.

feed.title: Simon Approaching End Of The Road With Struggling Suburban Boston Mall
feed.summary: Simon Property Group is likely to relinquish ownership of its Square One Mall in Saugus, Massachusetts, as the $76 million CMBS loan tied to the property has been transferred to special servicing and is deemed almost impossible to refinance. The mall's net cash flow has declined annually since 2022, and its inclusion in Simon's "Other Properties" category suggests it will be handed back to lenders. This comes even as the broader mall sector shows signs of recovery, with Simon focusing its investments on better-performing properties in the Boston area.

feed.title: Franklin Templeton switches fund to Putnam
feed.summary: Franklin Templeton Australia is appointing Putnam Investment Management LLC as the responsible manager for its Franklin Global Growth Fund, renaming it the Franklin Putnam Global Core Equity Fund. The move is driven by evolving investor preferences for lower-cost, diversified global equity options, with all changes expected by October 14.

feed.title: Amex accelerates its encroachment on business banking
feed.summary: American Express is enhancing its business banking offerings to compete with traditional banks and fintechs for small business clients. The company launched a high-yield business savings account, plans to integrate reward redemptions for its Graphite Business card members, and will introduce an AI-powered payroll system in early 2027. These initiatives are part of Amex's strategy to expand its full-service small business relationship by integrating banking, payroll, and payments into a single platform, especially as banks are increasing their small business lending.

This move is expected to generate significant annualized synergies, primarily from corporate and administrative efficiencies, and improve access to capital markets.

feed.title: ResMed stock jumps 3% on RBC Capital upgrade to Outperform

Analyst Craig Wong-Pan raised the price target to $262, citing ResMed's market leadership in obstructive sleep apnea devices and expected benefits from increased market awareness. The upgrade also considers a class 1 recall for a competitor's device, which is anticipated to further support ResMed's growth.

feed.title: Patrick Dempsey Is the New Face of Guardant Health’s ‘The Reckoning’ Campaign
feed.summary: Patrick Dempsey is spearheading Guardant Health's new multi-million dollar "The Reckoning" campaign, urging early colorectal cancer screening with Guardant's Shield™ blood test. The campaign highlights the rising death toll from colorectal cancer, particularly among younger adults, and promotes Shield™ as the first FDA-approved primary blood test for screening. Dempsey, a long-time cancer advocate, aims to reduce screening barriers and honor those affected by the disease.

feed.title: Biogen (BIIB) and AbbVie (ABBV) Get Wolfe Upgrades—Which Pharma Stock Has More Upside?
feed.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded Biogen (BIIB) and AbbVie (ABBV) to Outperform, assigning both $300 price targets due to undervalued pipelines and low valuations. Biogen's upgrade is driven by late-stage clinical programs and strategic M&A, while AbbVie's is based on strong patent positions and robust cash generation, particularly with its immunology drugs. The report contrasts their risk profiles, with Biogen offering higher upside potential linked to clinical catalysts and AbbVie presenting a more stable, longevity-focused investment.

feed.title: Hartford, Health Firm Resolve Stem Cell Litigation Coverage Suit
feed.summary: Hartford Insurance Group Inc. and an Illinois medical clinic have settled a dispute regarding coverage for litigation over alleged misleading marketing of stem cell treatments. The US District Court for the Central District of Illinois granted a joint voluntary dismissal motion without prejudice. The settlement resolves Hartford Underwriters Insurance Co.'s obligation to defend or indemnify Greater Peoria Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, doing business as Joseph Health Group, though the settlement details were not disclosed.

feed.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) Stock Price Down 6.7% - Time to Sell?
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) stock dropped 6.7% to $34.56, with trading volume 41% below average, as it tests support levels amid consumer-discretionary weakness and profit-taking. Despite the dip, the company is pursuing aggressive long-term growth with plans for up to 370 new restaurants in 2026 and an expanded Apprentice program. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average price target of $43.84, even as valuation remains elevated and international expansion carries execution and valuation risks.

feed.title: Boeing (BA) and RTX (RTX) Gain From Pentagon Missile Buildup, But Is the Upside Priced In?
feed.summary: The Pentagon has signed framework agreements with Boeing (BA) and RTX (RTX) to increase production of SM-3 interceptors, part of a broader U.S. missile buildup. While both companies benefit from the government's commitment to replenish missile inventories, the market's subdued reaction suggests that much of the upside might already be factored into their stock prices. RTX, with its record backlog and prominent role in missile defense systems, appears to be a more direct play on this theme compared to Boeing, which also deals with commercial aviation issues.

feed.title: Why Galveston Is Becoming a Cruise Capital Outside Florida
feed.summary: Galveston is rapidly expanding its cruise port operations, attracting major cruise lines like Carnival and Royal Caribbean with its proximity to 46 million potential passengers in Texas and surrounding states. This growth, fueled by significant port investments, is positioning Galveston as a major cruise hub, offering a convenient drive-to option for travelers in the middle of the country and bringing a distinct local flavor to cruises.

feed.title: Does Raised EPS Guidance Change The Bull Case For McKesson Stock (MCK)?
feed.summary: McKesson (MCK) recently increased its full-year EPS guidance, expecting 13-15% growth, and announced plans to rebrand its Medical-Surgical unit as Wellverse with a potential IPO in late 2027. The company is also acquiring Precision Medicine Group to enhance its oncology and biopharma services. While these developments signal operational strength and strategic expansion, the core investment narrative, including risks like drug pricing pressure and high leverage, remains largely unchanged.

feed.title: Broadridge expands to offer crypto and tokenized investments
feed.summary: Broadridge (BR) has announced an expansion into crypto and tokenized investments, allowing its clients to view these assets alongside their traditional stocks and bonds within the same portfolio. This move aims to integrate digital assets more seamlessly into existing investment management platforms. Scott Melker discussed this development on "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker."

feed.title: Norwegian Cruise Line contacted individuals on the Do Not Call Registry, a new class action lawsuit alleges
feed.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. by Irene Sorriento, alleging the company made unsolicited telemarketing calls to her cellphone, which has been on the National Do Not Call Registry since 2004. The complaint, filed on September 10, 2026, claims Sorriento received two vacation sales calls in April 2026, violating the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). The lawsuit seeks to represent a class of individuals who received multiple calls from Norwegian Cruise Line while their numbers were on the Do Not Call Registry, asking for damages and an injunction to stop future calls.

feed.title: Jim Cramer Says “Target’s Doing Better than Walmart Right Now”

He advised a nuanced buying strategy for Walmart due to its valuation, while acknowledging Target's stronger comparable sales momentum.
